title: 第26章 消息第27章 收留
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“天地灵珠，你到底在哪里！”
找了一下午都没有线索的石泉水，站在街边满心忧虑地看着西沉的太阳。
派人出去寻找柳无无，到了现在连派出去的人都没线索。
实在让人担心的很。
“云姐，这店都开了三百多年了，不能就这样轻易关门啊！”
前方的店门口一个老头弯着腰费力地捡拾地上的老物件。
石泉水也没心思去理会什么关门不关门，正想回去找老八，一股熟悉的香气再度袭来。
“嗯？怎么这里也有跟金小姐身上一样的香气。”
他嗅了嗅，顺着气味找下去，发现是从那捡东西的老头身后店里散发出来的。
老头刚捡完东西，急匆匆跑回店里，并没有留意身边站着人。
石泉水再次闻了闻，确认香气是从店内飘出来，这才抬腿进店。
店的面积并不小，长约20米，宽约14米，单单这个面积就附近几个店大了两倍不止。
里面还排满了货架，可以想象鼎盛时期这里会是怎样一副场景。
可惜，货架空空，哪怕打扫的干干净净，也难以让过路的人有进去的念头。
相对于落魄的店，角落的一只比拳头还大的蜘蛛倒是忙碌的很，四周有七八网，网上都有猎物在挣扎。
“你们谁是这里掌柜？”
正讨论的两人不由转过头，上了年纪以为是客人，便笑盈盈地上前拱手道：
“小的是店里伙计老陆，爷有什么需要的？”
这老陆牙齿都没剩几颗了，实在想象不出，这么大年纪了不回家享清福，呆在这里干什么。
石泉水知道不可能有线索，可还是用左右手圈出个圆圈，“百无聊赖道：

”你们这有没有这么大的珠子，或者见过类似的？”
“没有，也没见过，你们可以去对面的星月楼看看。”
云姐没说完就扭过身往内轩走去，她说的每个字里都包含的怒气和不甘。
“爷，实在对不住，掌柜的正为店里生意发愁。”
老陆眼看掌柜都离开了，只好一边赔罪一边请去旁边坐坐。
“那珠子有没有？”
“没有，本店从没有这样的。”
老陆躬身站在一旁，眼睛里好不容易有了一些光彩，听到是来问消息的，瞬间没了精神。
“我刚才闻到从你们店里散发出来的香气，是一种很特殊的香气，能否让我看看是什么？”
石泉水看他一副苦瓜脸，也不再细问。
“香气？”老陆嗅了下鼻子，忽然想起捡到的一件东西，“爷，小人早上捡到了一纱巾。”
纱巾？
早上？
时间对不上，应该不是那个在周阳镇擦肩而过的女子。。
老陆找到纱巾迅速递给石泉水。
content_en:
"Heaven and Earth Spirit Pearl, where are you?"
After searching for Shiquanshui for an entire afternoon with no clues, I stood on the street looking worriedly at the setting sun.
People were sent out to look for Liu Wuwu, but now even the people sent out had no clues.
It's really worrying.
"Sister Yun, this store has been open for more than three hundred years, we can't just close it so easily!"
At the front door of the store, an old man bent over and struggled to pick up old items on the ground.
Shi Quanshui didn't care about whether it was closed or not. Just when he was about to go back to find Lao Ba, a familiar aroma hit him again.
"Huh? Why does this place have the same fragrance as Miss Jin's."
He sniffed and followed the smell, and found that it was coming from the store behind the old man who was picking up things.
The old man had just finished picking up things and hurried back to the store without paying attention to the people standing next to him.
Shi Quan Shui smelled it again and confirmed that the aroma was coming from the store, and then walked into the store.
The area of ​​the store is not small, about 20 meters long and 14 meters wide. This area alone is more than twice the size of several nearby stores.
It is also filled with shelves, so you can imagine what it would have been like in its heyday.
Unfortunately, the shelves are empty, and even if they are cleaned, it is difficult for passers-by to even think about going in.
Compared to the poor shop, a spider bigger than a fist in the corner is very busy. There are seven or eight webs around it, and the prey is struggling on the web.
"Which one of you is the shopkeeper here?"
The two people who were discussing couldn't help but turn their heads. The old man thought they were guests, so he stepped forward with a smile and cupped his hands:
"The younger one is Lao Lu, the clerk in the store. What do you need?"
This old Lu doesn't have many teeth left. I really can't imagine why he is staying here at such an old age if he doesn't go home and enjoy happiness.
Shi Quanshui knew there would be no clues, but he still circled a circle with his left and right hands and said boredly:
"Have you ever seen such a big bead, or have you seen something similar?" "
"No, I haven't seen it before. You can go to the Xingyue Tower opposite to have a look. "
Sister Yun turned around and walked towards Neixuan before she finished speaking. Every word she said contained anger and unwillingness.
"Master, I'm really sorry, the shopkeeper is worried about the business of the store. "
Seeing that the shopkeeper had left, Lao Lu had no choice but to apologize and invite him to sit next to him.
"Do you have any beads? "
"No, this store has never been like this. "
Lao Lu stood aside with a bow, his eyes finally regained some brilliance. When he heard that he was here to ask for news, he instantly lost his energy.
"I just smelled the aroma coming from your store. It's a very special aroma. Can you let me see what it is? "
Shi Quanshui looked at him with a bitter look on his face and stopped asking further questions.
"Smell? "Lao Lu sniffed and suddenly remembered something he picked up, "Sir, I picked up a gauze scarf this morning. "
Gauze?
Morning?
The time didn't match up, so she probably wasn't the woman she passed by in Zhouyang Town. .
Lao Lu found the gauze scarf and quickly handed it to Shi Quanshui.
